$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Resource Manager (the 'Manage resources' page). See aws/s3.json for the contract. GCP/Azure claims have no AWS-wire probe — they are proven by 'tests' (conformance files run against the in-process router).

gcp.resource-manager.delete-project.title: Delete project
limitations: Vyomi deletes the project immediately. Real GCP soft-deletes a project for a 30-day recovery window (with an Undelete action) before it is purged for good; Vyomi has no recoverable-deleted-project state to restore from.

gcp.resource-manager.move-project.title: Move project (change parent folder/organization)
limitations: Moves are applied immediately; real GCP evaluates org-policy and IAM-inheritance side effects of the move (e.g. constraints on the destination), which Vyomi does not re-run.

gcp.resource-manager.folders.title: Folders (create, list, search, rename, move, delete/undelete) and project parent browse
limitations: Folder create/rename/move/delete return an already-completed long-running operation (real GCP returns a pending one you poll).
Nesting depth (10) and sibling-name uniqueness are enforced; folder IAM policies, org-policy inheritance through folders and the 30-day purge of DELETE_REQUESTED folders are not simulated.
